summary: Candidate is a distinct session_skill for classifying module origin during instrumentation initialization. It has no semantic overlap with existing skills (Path Command Execution is graphics-focused; Resolve Scala Standard Library Module Import is Scala-specific dependency resolution). Peer candidates operate at different stages (eligibility filtering, SDK installation, agent initialization) and do not subsume this path-inspection capability. The skill addresses a specific, well-defined objective (classify_module_origin) with concrete workflow steps and cross-platform path normalization logic that should be preserved as a new capability.
